subject: Lakeside Laboratory
text: Diving 9 meters to the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool by holding A earns a Piece of Heart from the old man.

evidence.quote:
9 meters in the pool is the goal, and each 
second amounts to a meter. Once you do a full dive, talk to the old man again 
and he should give you another Piece of Heart.

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located behind the stone pillar across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote:
While riding Epona, 
jump across the broken bridge in an awesome-looking cutscene to cross to the 
other side. While here, make sure it's night, and look behind the stone pillar 
for another Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the tent across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote:
Now look behind 
the tent for another. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 050 out of 100)

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: In the southeastern entrance of Dodongo's Cavern, playing the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to Hookshot up to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Once inside, head to the southeastern entrance (with the Baby Dodongos) 
and at one point, Navi will fly up to somewhere high. While she's up there, 
play the Scarecrow's Song to summon a scarecrow up where Navi was. Hookshot to 
it and you'll find the last Gold Skulltula of this dungeon.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch
text: Beating Malon's obstacle course by finishing two laps around Lon Lon Ranch in under 50 seconds rewards a cow sent to Link's house.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Malon twice over at the 
horse stable and agree to try to beat her horse riding record....This is an obstacle course around the track. You 
have to finish two laps in under 50 seconds....If you succeed, Malon will give you a present so 
big that you can't carry it, so she'll send it to your house in Kokiri Forest. 
It's actually a cow, so you can get Lon Lon Milk right at your house.

subject: Advanced Spin Slash
text: The Advanced Spin Slash is performed by holding B until the sword glows yellow, then releasing.

evidence.quote: Advanced Spin Slash (Hold B until the sword is yellow, then release)

subject: House of Twins
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the back of the House of Twins in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, kill them, and head to where the 
House of Twins is at, and you'll notice a Gold Skulltula on the back of the 
house.

subject: Secret Cave
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the Gossip Stone outside the Lost Woods entrance reveals a Secret Cave with a treasure chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Before entering, play the Song of Storms near the Gossip Stone up here to 
reveal a Secret Cave. This contains a treasure chest with a Red Rupee inside, 
if you're bothered enough to get it.

subject: Odd Mushroom
text: Waking the sleeping bum in the Lost Woods with Cojiro rewards the Odd Mushroom, which spoils in 3 minutes.

evidence.quote:
Head left to find a bum who 
thinks everyone but him is disgusting. Well, wake him up with Cojiro, his 
chicken. So that's where Cojiro's owner went! He'll give you an Odd Mushroom 
in return. This item will spoil in 3 minutes, and you're supposed to give him 
a potion made with this.

subject: Odd Potion
text: Giving the Odd Mushroom before it spoils to the witch in the hidden Potion Shop behind the red house in Kakariko Village yields the Odd Potion.

evidence.quote:
From this shop, 
head through the back door, then enter the red house to find a hidden witch's 
Potion Shop. Give her the Odd Mushroom (if it hasn't spoiled) and she'll make 
an Odd Potion with it.

subject: Poacher's Saw
text: Giving the Odd Potion to the Kokiri girl in the Lost Woods rewards the saw left behind by the bum.

evidence.quote:
Head all the way back to where the bum was in Lost Woods, and you'll see a 
Kokiri girl in his place....In return for 
giving the girl the potion, she'll give you the saw he left behind.

subject: Mido
text: From the Lost Woods entrance, going right, left, and right leads to Mido, who allows passage once Saria's Song is played for him.

evidence.quote:
Now, head 
back to the entrance to Lost Woods, then head right, left, right, and you'll 
find Mido blocking the correct entrance here. Play Saria's Song for him and 
he'll let you through.

subject: Lost Woods
text: At night, riding the Magic Bean plant in the grassy area past Mido leads to a Gold Skulltula reachable with a sword slash.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, after going through the entrance Mido was blocking, head left once more
to get back to the grassy area. Making sure it's night, ride the Magic Bean 
plant and it'll take you to a Golden Skulltula. It's just reachable for a 
sword slash.

subject: Secret Cave
text: Bombing a Secret Cave in the Sacred Forest Meadow and defeating two Wolfos reveals a small chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
First, place a bomb somewhere around here to open a Secret Cave which contains 
two Wolfos. Kill them both to reveal a small chest containing a Purple Rupee.

subject: Large Moblin
text: Large Moblins in the Sacred Forest Meadow maze charge when Link enters their sight, allowing Link to sneak behind them and slash them.

evidence.quote:
Large Moblins are now invading this place. 
What you have to do is be in their sight so that they'll charge, and you have 
to sneak up behind them. Once you are behind them, slash them to kill them.

subject: Sacred Forest Meadow
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on a wall reached by climbing the ladder at the end of the Sacred Forest Meadow maze hedges.

evidence.quote:
Once you get past here, climb the ladder at the end to get on top of the 
hedges. Look around on one of the walls to find another Gold Skulltula.

subject: Club Moblin
text: The club Moblin smashes shockwaves that must be dodged to reach and slash him three times to defeat him.

evidence.quote:
With this 
one, it has a club, and wherever you are, it'll smash its club, creating a wave 
that'll move toward you. You have to keep dodging these until you reach him, 
then slash him to damage him. After that, you'll have to do it over again. Do 
it twice more after the first time to kill him, then continue to the Forest 
Temple's entrance.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: Sheik teaches the Minuet of Forest at the Sacred Forest Meadow, which warps Link back to the Forest Temple entrance when played.

evidence.quote:
You'll encounter Sheik. He'll tell you about a few things, then teach you the
MINUET OF FOREST, which will warp you here whenever you play it.

subject: Tree
text: In the entrance area of the Forest Temple, climbing vines on the wall and jumping to the tree reveals a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Walk a few steps forward and two Wolfos will pop out. Use the tactic in the 
Enemy list section to defeat them, then find some vines on a wall. Climb up 
them, and you'll find a small chest on the tree on the other side. Jump over to 
it and open the chest to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: Forest Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is located around the vines near the entrance of the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote:
Around the vines you climbed 
is a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 055 out of 100)

subject: Main Room
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the right wall across from the entrance before the opposite door in the Forest Temple main room.

evidence.quote:
First, head 
straight across to the door on the opposite side. Before entering, take a look 
over at the right wall. You'll see another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 
056 out of 100)

subject: Blue Bubble
text: Shielding against an attacking Blue Bubble extinguishes its flames, leaving it vulnerable to sword slashes.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter, shield, as a Blue Bubble (a flaming skull) will try to 
hit you. If you shield successfully, its flames will go out and all you have 
to do is slash it until it's dead.

subject: Stalfos Room
text: Defeating two Stalfos by jump striking when their shields are lowered reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Continue onward and you'll encounter two 
Stalfos, like the young Kokiri girl mentioned....What you have to do is jump strike them when they 
don't have their shield out....If you manage to defeat 
them both, a chest containing another SMALL KEY will appear.

subject: Time Block
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the block in the right hallway makes the block disappear.

evidence.quote:
Head to the right hallway, and while standing in front of the block there, play
the Song of Time to make it disappear.

subject: Dungeon Map Room
text: Defeating the Blue Bubble in the upper room past the vines unseals the doors and spawns a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Inside, another Blue 
Bubble will immediately attack. Kill it and the doors will open back up and a 
large chest will appear. Open it to get, you guessed it, the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Well
text: Stepping on the red switch drains the river and well, where a small chest with a Small Key can be found at the bottom.

evidence.quote:
Step on the red 
switch to lower the water level of the river. Drop down to the bottom.  You'll 
notice that the well is now completely drained. Drop down it and follow the 
hall to a small chest with a SMALL KEY.

subject: Courtyard Ledge
text: Hookshotting to the back of the small chest on the high ledge reaches the chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot to its 
backside (the side facing the wall) and you'll successfully climb up there....Inside this chest is a RECOVERY HEART

subject: Courtyard Ledge
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall above the ledge reached by Hookshotting to the chest's backside.

evidence.quote:
Hookshot to its 
backside (the side facing the wall) and you'll successfully climb up there....Inside this chest is a RECOVERY HEART, but the real reason why we're up 
here is for a Gold Skulltula. It's on one of the walls up here. (GOLD
SKULLTULAS: 057 out of 100)

subject: Block Puzzle
text: In the west room, pull the block out into the corridor, push it along the ground arrow until it hits the wall, then push it from the upper hallway into the crevice.

evidence.quote:
Shortly thereafter, Navi will interrupt you. After she's done, look 
left and you'll see a block. Grab this and pull it to where you were, then 
follow the arrow on the ground and push the block that way until it reaches a 
wall. Now head back to the hallway where the block was...blocking...and 
continue up here and push the block until it falls into a little crevice.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Visiting the Skulltula house in Kakariko Village rewards another Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Now get back clear to 
Kakariko Village. Visit the Skulltula house and you'll get another Piece of 
Heart for your troubles!
